title: Compliance deadlines and open requests tracker
prompt: Monitor upcoming compliance deadlines and open close or audit requests. Summarize overdue items and missing evidence each week.
steps: pull open audit requests and close checklist items from Dime
list deadlines within 30 days, overdue items and requests with missing evidence
write the tracker; no message leaves the desk

done.text: Every exception row cites the calendar line or the request id
compliance-tracker.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Only deadlines from the verified calendar are used; nothing is sent to anyone outside Dime
